program: GLHS R4 — Governed Read-to-Write Continuity (GRWC) / Exact-Disclosure Admission

invariants.rule_provenance_locking: No claim-bearing R4 experiment may execute or seal until system_under_test_sha, experiment_harness_sha, active_branch, and literature_freeze_sha are verified and prospectively frozen.
invariants.rule_chronological_precedence: Strict chronological precedence: freeze_timestamp_utc < execution_started_utc <= execution_completed_utc <= validated_at_utc <= sealed_at_utc.
invariants.rule_backend_truthfulness: Simulated backends must never be labeled or claimed as PostgreSQL instances; actual database executions must run against PostgreSQL 16 under Serializable Snapshot Isolation (SSI).
invariants.rule_exact_disclosure_continuity: Persistent clinical write proposals must demonstrate cryptographic continuity to the exact model-visible projection (H_proj) supplied to inference.
invariants.rule_undisclosed_evidence_rejection: Proposals asserting clinical evidence present in the database but omitted from the model-visible disclosure projection must be strictly rejected.
invariants.rule_anti_downgrade_lineage: Human adaptations and reviewed proposals cannot strip root inference bindings to bypass write-admission checks.
